55/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept and purpose of the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S1.subgoal: Describe the five main stages and sub-stages of the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S2.subgoal: Identify the various coordinate systems involved in the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S3.subgoal: Explain the trade-offs between object representation detail and computational efficiency.

55/S4.subgoal: Categorize the broad techniques used for 3D object representation.

55/S5.subgoal: Describe specialized representation techniques for complex or photorealistic objects.

55/S6.subgoal: Summarize the stages and overall process of the 3D graphics pipeline.
